stories.title: Armed Forces and Emergency Services Day added to Mold’s Sunday market this weekend
stories.summary: The Sunday Gathering Artisan Market returns to Mold town centre this Sunday with an Armed Forces and Emergency Services Day bringing together military and blue light organisations from across north Wales. stories.summary: A primary school in Mold has won a national climate award after its pupils researched ways to cut waste across their school and local community. stories.title: Flintshire County Council thanks residents for supporting waste and recycling crews during heatwave
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has praised its waste and recycling crews for completing collections during a recent spell of extreme heat, with residents across the county offering cold drinks, ice creams and words of support to staff working in heavy uniforms. stories.title: Welsh Ambulance Service declares critical incident amid surge in 999 calls
stories.summary: The Welsh Ambulance Service declared a critical incident at noon on Friday after a sharp rise in 999 calls, including patients with serious and life-threatening conditions awaiting a response. Call volume this week has increased by 31 per cent compared to the same period two weeks ago, with Thursday more than 50 per cent higher.
